units.source_text: 昔源氏有“光君”之称，桐壶帝对他宠爱无比。

en.t: In former times, Genji was known as the Shining Lord, and Emperor Kiritsubo loved him beyond measure.

units.source_text: 但因妒忌之人甚多，又因他的母亲没有后援人，以致处境困难。

en.t: But because many people envied him, and because his mother had no one to support her, his position was difficult.

units.source_text: 全靠他能深思远虑，圆滑应付世事，韬晦不露锋芒。

en.t: He survived only because he could think deeply and look far ahead, deal smoothly with worldly affairs, and conceal his talents without showing his edge.

units.source_text: 因此后来世局变迁，天下大乱，他终于平安无事地渡过难关，依然矢志不懈地勤修后世。

en.t: Thus, when later political fortunes shifted and the realm fell into great turmoil, he passed safely through the crisis and continued without wavering to devote himself to preparing for the world to come.

units.source_text: 他对万事不逞威福，故能悠然度送一生。

en.t: He never wielded power or favor in any matter, and so he was able to pass his life in calm ease.

units.source_text: 现在这位薰君年事尚幼，声名早扬，并且已经怀抱高远之志。

en.t: Now this Lord Kaoru, though still young, had already gained an early reputation and cherished lofty ambitions.

units.source_text: 可见具有宿世深缘，并非凡胎俗骨，竟有佛菩萨暂时下凡之相。

en.t: One could see that he had deep karmic ties from former lives; he was no ordinary mortal, but seemed almost like a Buddha or bodhisattva temporarily descended to earth.

units.source_text: 他的相貌并无特别可指之优点，亦无可使见者极口赞美之处。

en.t: His appearance had no particular feature that could be singled out as superior, nor anything that would make onlookers praise him to the utmost.

units.source_text: 只是神情异常优雅，能令见者自觉羞惭。

en.t: Yet his bearing was extraordinarily graceful, making those who saw him feel ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 而其心境之深远，又迥非常人可比。

en.t: And the depth and breadth of his mind were far beyond comparison with ordinary people.

units.source_text: 尤其是他身上有一股香气，这香气不是这世间的香气。

en.t: Above all, there was a fragrance about his body, and this fragrance was not of this world.

units.source_text: 真奇怪：他的身体略微一动，香气便会随风飘到很远的地方，真是百步之外也闻得到的。

en.t: It was truly strange: if his body moved even slightly, the fragrance would drift far away on the wind, so that it could be sensed even a hundred paces off.

units.source_text: 凡是像他那样身份高贵的人，谁也不肯粗头乱服，不加修饰，总是用心打扮，务求自己比别人漂亮，借以引人注目。

en.t: People of such high rank as his would never appear unkempt or plainly dressed, but always took care with their adornment, trying to look more beautiful than others and thereby attract attention.

units.source_text: 但在薰君情况不同，只因身有异香，所以即使偷偷地躲在暗处，也有浓香四溢，无可隐藏。

en.t: But Lord Kaoru was different: because his body had this strange fragrance, even if he secretly hid in the dark, the rich scent spread everywhere and could not be concealed.

units.source_text: 他很讨厌，衣服从来不加薰香。

en.t: He greatly disliked this, and he never perfumed his robes.

units.source_text: 然而，许多衣柜中藏有各种名香，加上他身上固有的香气，浓得不可言喻。

en.t: Even so, many wardrobes held all kinds of famous incense, and together with the natural fragrance of his body, the scent became indescribably rich.

units.source_text: 庭前的梅花树，只要和他的衣袖略微接触，花气便特别芬芳。

en.t: The plum tree before the garden became especially fragrant if it so much as brushed lightly against his sleeve.

units.source_text: 春雨中树上的水点滴在人身上，便有许多人衣香不散。

en.t: When drops of spring rain fell from the trees onto people, the fragrance lingered on many of their robes without fading.

units.source_text: 秋野中无主的“藤袴”，一经他接触，原来的香气便消失，而另有一种异香随风飘来。

en.t: When he touched the ownerless thoroughwort blooming in the autumn fields, its original scent vanished, and another strange fragrance came drifting on the wind.

units.source_text: 凡他所采摘过的花，香气都特别馥郁。

en.t: Every flower he picked became especially rich in fragrance.
